what: First code executed on the physical Courier by this project: a 19-byte routine placed in RAM and hooked onto the firmware's tick.

hook.atomic: one word write; the offset 0x0a77 is valid under both segments, so the board never holds a half-updated far pointer

cleanup.ram_restored: pages 03a00 and 03b00 back to entirely zero

limits: The counter was sampled by page reads about 270 ms apart, so the rate is a fit over 3.5 s rather than an instantaneous measure.

This measures the rate at which vector 0x0f is delivered, which is the supervisor's countdown-chain tick. It is the same quantity the S-register conversion and Timer 0 max count describe, but it is not a direct measurement of Timer 0.
Nothing was written outside 0x3a77..0x3a89, 0x3b00..0x3b01 and the vector segment cell at 0x3e.
